build_radius_graph_pbc_nvidia: build a python module to generate a radius graph with periodic boundary conditions using NVIDIA nvalchemiops acceleration
run_get_neighbors_nvidia: run a nearest neighbor search on atomic positions with PBC using NVIDIA nvalchemiops and return edge indices and cell offsets
run_get_neighbors_nvidia_atoms: run a nearest neighbor search on an ASE Atoms object using NVIDIA nvalchemiops and return center indices, neighbor indices, distances, and offsets
refactor_get_neighbors_nvidia_batched: refactor the get_neighbors_nvidia function to support batched atomic structures with per-structure cell tensors and PBC flags
review_radius_graph_pbc_nvidia_interface: review the radius_graph_pbc_nvidia function to verify it is a drop-in replacement for radius_graph_pbc and radius_graph_pbc_v2
